best_attempt.rule_text:
title: Potential Domain Account Enumeration Commands
id: f437285f-c73e-4018-a680-d16df8518686
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of commands used to enumerate domain accounts as seen in Atomic Red Team tests for T1087.002.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
- attack.discovery
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel1:
    CommandLine|contains: net user net group
  sel2:
    CommandLine|contains: /get-localgroupmember -get-aduser -*
  sel3:
    CommandLine|contains: query
  condition: 1 of sel*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative use of net user, net group, query, or PowerShell scripts for account management.
level: medium

title: Adfind Execution
id: 27a5ec99-2ef8-4473-a622-04680d2cb904
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of adfind.exe, a tool commonly used for Active Directory reconnaissance.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_adfind_image:
    OriginalFileName: adfind.exe
  selection_adfind_commandline:
    CommandLine|contains: adfind.exe
  condition: (selection_adfind_image or selection_adfind_commandline)
falsepositives:
- Legitimate use of adfind.exe by administrators for authorized Active Directory queries.
level: high

id: c49e412d-4ab5-470c-b968-45ba06796dba

title: Potential Domain Account Enumeration via Network Connection
id: 3e493f1c-ab33-4225-a9c7-1598d3c45b41
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious network connections associated with domain account enumeration techniques using tools like
  net, dsquery, ldapsearch, or dscacheutil.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_suspicious_image:
    Image|contains|all:
    - \net.exe
    - \dsquery.exe
    - \ldapsearch
    - \dscacheutil
  selection_domain_port:
    DestinationPort:
    - '>389'
    - '>636'
    - '>3268'
    - '>3269'
  condition: selection_suspicious_image and selection_domain_port
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative use of directory services tools by authorized personnel.
level: high

title: Domain Account Enumeration Attempts
id: ed9367d2-4cb4-4c9d-b604-667630dbcfd8
status: experimental
description: Detects command-line indicators of domain account enumeration techniques (T1087.002) such as net user/group /domain,
  query user/session/process, PowerShell AD enumeration, and adfind.exe usage.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
- attack.discovery
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_net:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - net user /domain
    - net group /domain
  selection_query:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - query user
    - query session
    - query process
  selection_ps:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - Get-ADUser
    - Get-LocalGroupMember
  selection_adfind:
    Image|endswith: adfind.exe
  condition: selection_net or selection_query or selection_ps or selection_adfind
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative use of net user/group, query, or PowerShell AD modules by authorized personnel.
level: high

title: Potential Domain Account Enumeration via ADFind or Net/PowerShell
id: eab1703a-3966-4385-b9b2-12b690f58bf5
status: experimental
description: "Detects execution of adfind.exe with common reconnaissance command-line arguments, or usage of net user/group\n\
  \  /domain, or PowerShell cmdlets for AD enumeration, indicative of T1087.002."
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
- attack.discovery
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_adfind:
    Image|endswith: \adfind.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - lockoutduration
    - admincountdmp
    - (objectcategory=
  selection_net:
    Image|endswith: \net.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - user /domain
    - group /domain
  selection_ps:
    Image|endswith: \powershell.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - get-aduser
    - get-localgroupmember
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: high

title: Potential Domain Reconnaissance Activity
id: 0a4d208b-6f8a-4521-82a1-934cd10df8c3
status: experimental
description: Detects command-line tools commonly used for Active Directory reconnaissance, such as net, adfind, or powershell
  scripts querying domain information.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_recon_tools:
    Image|contains:
    - net.exe
    - adfind.exe
  selection_ps_suspicious:
    Image|endswith: powershell.exe
    Initiated|contains:
    - get-aduser
    - get-localgroupmember
    - Invoke-Expression
    - Invoke-WebRequest
  condition: selection_recon_tools or selection_ps_suspicious
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative use of net.exe or PowerShell for domain queries.
level: high

title: Detection of AdFind.exe Usage for Active Directory Reconnaissance
id: 6f4e405d-ae2a-4548-8e99-41d84a0f6950
status: experimental
description: "Detects execution of Adfind.exe utility with command-line arguments indicative of Active Directory reconnaissance\n\
  \  activities such as enumerating admin accounts or querying password policy."
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1087.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    OriginalFileName: AdFind.exe
  selection_cmd_admincount:
    CommandLine|contains: -sc admincountdmp
  selection_cmd_password_policy:
    CommandLine|contains: -default -s base lockoutduration lockoutthreshold lockoutobservationwindow maxpwdage minpwdage minpwdlength
      pwdhistorylength pwdproperties
  selection_cmd_ldapfilter:
    CommandLine|contains: -f (
  condition: (selection_image and (selection_cmd_admincount or selection_cmd_password_policy or selection_cmd_ldapfilter))
falsepositives:
- Legitimate use of AdFind.exe by administrators for authorized Active Directory audits.
level: high

values: -default -s base lockoutduration lockoutthreshold lockoutobservationwindow maxpwdage minpwdage minpwdlength pwdhistorylength pwdproperties

spec_observables: -default -s base lockoutduration lockoutthreshold lockoutobservationwindow maxpwdage minpwdage minpwdlength pwdhistorylength pwdproperties

title: Potential Domain Account Enumeration Activity
id: 93cb1ed4-06c3-47ad-af41-e9a258031d7a
status: experimental
description: Detects commands used to enumerate domain accounts as per T1087.002, including net user/net group, dscacheutil,
  ldapsearch, adfind, ADRecon, and query.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
- attack.discovery
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel_net_user_domain:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: net user /domain
  sel_net_group_domain:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: net group /domain
  sel_dscacheutil_q_group:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: dscacheutil -q group
  sel_ldapsearch:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: ldapsearch
  sel_atomic_test1:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: net user net group
  sel_atomic_test2:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: /get-localgroupmember -get-aduser -*
  sel_query_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: query
  sel_adrecon_path:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: $env:TEMP\\ADRecon.ps1
  sel_invoke_expression:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: Invoke-Expression#{adrecon_path}
  sel_remove_item:
    CommandLine|contains|contains: Remove-Item#{adrecon_path}
  sel_adfind_image:
    Image|endswith|endswith: adfind.exe
  filter_reg_query:
    Image|endswith|endswith: reg.exe
    CommandLine|contains|contains: QUERY
  condition: (sel_net_user_domain or sel_net_group_domain or sel_dscacheutil_q_group or sel_ldapsearch or sel_atomic_test1
    or sel_atomic_test2 or sel_query_cmd or sel_adrecon_path or sel_invoke_expression or sel_remove_item or sel_adfind_image)
    and not filter_reg_query
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: high

title: Potential Domain Account Enumeration via Various Tools
id: 41bfdb41-e064-4443-9d2e-2baad6d3478c
status: experimental
description: Detects command-line patterns associated with domain account discovery techniques such as net user/net group,
  PowerShell enumeration, query, ADRecon usage, and AdFind executions.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087.002
- attack.discovery
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel_net_user_net_group:
    CommandLine: net user net group
  sel_ps_get_localgroupmember:
    CommandLine|contains: /get-localgroupmember -get-aduser -*
  sel_query:
    CommandLine: query
  sel_adrecon_invoke:
    CommandLine|contains: Invoke-Expression#{adrecon_path}
  sel_adrecon_remove:
    CommandLine|contains: Remove-Item#{adrecon_path}
  sel_adrecon_check:
    CommandLine|contains: ifTest-Path#{adrecon_path})
  sel_adfind_lockout:
    CommandLine|contains: '#{adfind_path} -default -s base lockoutduration lockoutthreshold lockoutobservationwindow maxpwdage
      minpwdage minpwdlength pwdhistorylength pwdproperties'
  sel_adfind_check:
    CommandLine|contains: ifTest-Path#{adfind_path})
  sel_adfind_admincount:
    CommandLine|contains: '#{adfind_path} -sc admincountdmp'
  sel_adfind_id:
    CommandLine|contains: 514e7e3e-b3b4-4a67-af60-be20f139198b
  condition: 1 of sel_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative use of net, query, PowerShell modules, ADRecon, or AdFind tools.
level: medium

values: #{adfind_path} -default -s base lockoutduration lockoutthreshold lockoutobservationwindow maxpwdage minpwdage minpwdlength pwdhistorylength pwdproperties

spec_observables: #{adfind_path} -default -s base lockoutduration lockoutthreshold lockoutobservationwindow maxpwdage minpwdage minpwdlength pwdhistorylength pwdproperties
